translation: Greatly cold, non-toxic. It descends the water of the bladder, [removes] retained heat-qi in the abdomen, evil water of between the skin rising out, swelling of the face and eyes, sudden wind-heat of the body with prickly-heat itching (風熱痱癢), and benefits [the bowels]; taken for a long time it makes one deficient. One name is 丁歷 (dīnglì), one name is 蒿 (tíng) artemisia.
